name: Hail
description: The pan's first arrival: it has noticed you, and says so in every direction at once. A boss seen from above, a slate mass on eight thick legs with twelve steel-grey stones stuck round its rim, each with a frost face — the ring it throws (EnemyType.shotFan, a full turn of `ss.enemy.hailstone`) drawn as the body's own edge, so the lumpy outline is the attack. A pit at +x with three frost eyes in it, and the organ large in the middle. The `churn` clip creeps the ring one stone round the body every cycle, seamlessly, and is authored at the game's 2.6s cadence. `enraged` cracks the mass, turns the eyes ember and lights the stones frost. Never mirrored: a ring has no side. Gameplay radius 40. The `death` clip throws every stone at once and cracks the mass under them.

enraged.description: Halfway: the mass cracked open along three seams, the eyes gone ember, every stone lit from within. It stops standing off here and comes at you, still hailing.

churn.description: the ring of stones creeps one place round the body every cycle, seamlessly, with a shudder of the mass where the game's ring leaves; eight legs walk and the three eyes pulse out of step

death.description: every stone leaves the ring at once and fades — the last thing it does is the thing it did — while the mass cracks and shrinks under them, the legs fold, the eyes go out one by one and the organ flares out
